rule.statement: An ineffective decree passed by a lower court should be set aside and the case remanded to the lower court, keeping it open for the appellants to move the court to have the abatement set aside if they are so entitled in law.
rule.supporting_quote: In the present appeal, as clearly stated earlier, prior to the judgment of the District Court dated 20.05.2005, the 15th respondent who was the 16A respondent as well had died on 30.05.2004. No steps were taken for substitution of parties.
